description: Canonical names for disputed_territories_wms (WMS only; not used by ingestion).
geometry_hints: Optional geometry_ewkt (PostGIS EWKT, SRID=4326;...) overrides pair/bbox for any kind. pair_relation_ids [a,b] must exist as countries.country_id. bbox for unclaimed_territory. geometry_requirement documents rows still NULL when no EWKT and no auto hint.

kinds.disputed_tagged: Areas with disputed / disputed_by / claimed_by tags in OSM.
kinds.unclaimed_territory: Land not claimed by any sovereign in OSM sense (e.g. Bir Tawil).
